critical_blockers.title: No Checkpoint/Resume Mechanism for Paused Executions
critical_blockers.description: When agents pause execution, system loses state. Cannot resume with reconstructed context.
critical_blockers.impact: Complete autonomy failure - agent cannot pause and resume

critical_blockers.title: Manual Approval Gates on Low-Confidence Decisions
critical_blockers.description: All decisions with <70% confidence require manual human approval.

critical_blockers.title: No Dependency Resolution Query Interface
critical_blockers.description: Agents cannot ask 'what must complete before this task?'

critical_blockers.title: No Unified Task/Track State Query API
critical_blockers.description: State scattered across 7+ file locations with no canonical query interface.

critical_blockers.title: No Structured Agent Handoff Protocol
critical_blockers.description: 7 ad-hoc handoff mechanisms with state losses: STM 100%, rationale 80%, context 100%.
critical_blockers.impact: Knowledge lost at each agent transition

critical_blockers.title: No Autonomous Verification that Remediations Worked
critical_blockers.description: Assumes exit code 0 = success. No validation that problem is solved.
critical_blockers.impact: Can apply incorrect fixes that appear successful

critical_blockers.title: MCP GitHub Server Lacks Write Capability
critical_blockers.description: Cannot commit/push via MCP; forces bash+git workarounds.
critical_blockers.impact: No reliable way to persist state changes

critical_blockers.title: No Crash Recovery or Idempotency Guarantees
critical_blockers.description: If agent crashes mid-execution, cannot detect or resume safely.
critical_blockers.impact: Crash leaves repo in inconsistent state

summary.agents_can: Execute 3-5 sequential decisions within one session before approval gates/state loss force human intervention
